slides.title: You judge a session by tomorrow's stairs.
slides.body: Can't sit down without a noise? Must have been a good day. That's the trap.

slides.title: Soreness tracks new, not good.
slides.body: New movements, new ranges and lots of lowering make you sore. Getting stronger doesn't have to.

slides.title: Same program, less soreness?
slides.body: It hasn't stopped working. Your body adapted. That's the point.

slides.title: Chasing sore wrecks the next session.
slides.body: Smash Monday, limp through Tuesday and Wednesday. One big day, two lost.

slides.title: Track what the bar says.
slides.body: More weight, more reps, cleaner reps, faster times. That's progress. Soreness is a side effect.

slides.title: Leave able to train tomorrow.
slides.body: The best session is the one that lets you come back and do it again.
